title: EU VIES VAT Number Batch Validator & Reverse-Charge Check Input

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: validate_batch validates a list of EU/XI VAT numbers; member_state_status checks availability of all 28 national VAT databases; vat_rates returns VAT rates per Member State from the European Commission TEDB (standard, reduced, super-reduced, parking; optionally for CN/CPA codes or categories).
enumTitles: EU VAT rates by country / product (TEDB)

vatNumbers.title: VAT numbers to validate
vatNumbers.description: List of EU/XI VAT numbers with country prefix (e.g. 'FI01120389', 'FI10728943', 'DE123456789'). Spaces, dots, and hyphens are stripped automatically.

supplierCountryCode.title: Supplier country code (for reverse-charge check)
supplierCountryCode.description: Two-letter EU country code of the seller/supplier (e.g. 'FI', 'DE') to flag cross-border B2B reverse-charge candidates.

requesterMemberStateCode.title: Requester Member State code (optional)
requesterMemberStateCode.description: Optional requester EU Member State code if requesting an official VIES consultation reference identifier.

requesterNumber.title: Requester VAT number without prefix (optional)
requesterNumber.description: Optional requester VAT number (without country prefix) to obtain a VIES consultation requestIdentifier.

includeMemberStateStatus.title: Also output Member State availability table
includeMemberStateStatus.description: When true in validate_batch mode, also writes the 28 Member State VIES availability rows.

vatRateCountries.title: VAT rates: countries
vatRateCountries.description: vat_rates mode: EU Member State codes (GR accepted as EL; XI = Northern Ireland). Empty = all 27.

vatRateDate.title: VAT rates: situation on (YYYY-MM-DD)
vatRateDate.description: vat_rates mode: date the rates should apply on. Default today.

cnCodes.title: VAT rates: CN codes
cnCodes.description: vat_rates mode: optional Combined Nomenclature goods codes (e.g. 4901 books) to get the rate that applies to them.

cpaCodes.title: VAT rates: CPA codes
cpaCodes.description: vat_rates mode: optional CPA service codes (e.g. 55.10).

vatRateCategories.title: VAT rates: TEDB categories
vatRateCategories.description: vat_rates mode: optional TEDB category identifiers (e.g. FOODSTUFFS, BOOKS).
